section_heading: 4.3.5 FIRE EQUIPMENT HIRE, 4.4 SECURITY SERVICES, 4.5 FRESH WATER, 4.6 ELECTRICITY, 4.7 REMOVAL OF REFUSE, 4.8 COMBATING OF OIL POLLUTION
plain_summary: This page lists tariffs for various services. It details rates for hiring fire equipment, including training facilities, fire pumps, ejector pumps, fire hoses, branch pipes and nozzles, fire extinguishers, and a fire tender with driver for social functions. It also specifies a daily rate for crew transportation services provided by the Authority's security for vessels at Island View berths 1-8 in the Port of Durban. Fees for fresh water, electricity, and refuse removal are stated as 'available on application'. For combating oil pollution, there is an hourly rate for the utilization of an oil boom, while fees for oil spill emulsifier and any tugs used are 'on application' or 'raised separately'.

calculation_relevant_numbers.context: Training Facilities Hire per day (excluding fire equipment)
Branch pipe and nozzle hire (per 8 hr day)
Fire tender and driver – social functions (per hour)
Utilization of oil boom per hour or part thereof

previous_page_dependency_reason: The general tariff conditions, including the VAT rate and currency, are established on the previous page. The section numbering (4.3.5) indicates a continuation of the 'FIRE EQUIPMENT' section from the previous page (4.3.4).
